Guidance & outlook: The global outlook for the exhibition and MICE (Meetings, Incen tives, Conferences and Exhibitions) industry for FY 2026-27 is expected to evolve in response to several key trends and developments.

The following are the key aspects likely to shape the global outlook: (a) Scale and Structure of the Global Exhibition Industry: The global exhibition industry operates across approximately 1, 530 venues offering about 44.3 million square metres of indoor exhibition space.

(b) Growth Outlook for the Global MICE Industry: The global MICE industry is projected to grow from approximatel y USD 0.87 trillion in calendar year 2025 to over USD 1.4 trillion by calendar year 2030, reflecting a compound annual growth rate of approximately 9.97% over the forecast period.
Growth & demand: Asia-Pacific is expected to be the fastest growing MICE market globally, with a projected compound annual growth rate o f between 10% and 13% through calendar year 2030.
